cell_metrics.top1_rule: minimum directional conditional bits per probe byte; lexical family ID breaks exact numeric ties
cell_metrics.generator_disjoint_accuracy: accuracy on locked test probes from family_p, polygraphic_fractionating, structured_generator and matched_null, whose generating regimes are absent from training
cell_metrics.matched_null_false_positive_rate: fraction of matched_null locked probes predicted as any non-null family
cell_metrics.median_own_rank: median rank of the true family among all thirteen references
cell_metrics.median_ncd_order_gap: median absolute forward/reverse NCD difference over family-reference pairs

probe_consensus.voters: only cells in the maximal qualifying cross-cell support set
probe_consensus.acceptance: winner receives votes from at least two mandatory compressors and at least four representations, including codepoint_u32_ws and at least one recurrence representation
